text.tspan: The five release triggers — R1 to R5
no — item may still be upstairs
a released item is the OWNER'S,
whatever the rental status says — F5
retrievedAt set · bay returns to AVAILABLE
nothing new may be assigned here
drop_item to the Pi — NO durations sent.
The Pi reads its own calibrated 17-23s
actuator extends: item falls to the
releasedAt written ONLY on the Pi's ack
F2 live session or open door
the admin-set hours of the day
with the item still in a bay
F6 · nobody collects within the deadline
raises an admin escalation and nothing else.
An unclaimed physical object is a human decision
